name: Nevada SB 276 (2025): local governments must notify NDEP of sewage discharges; NDEP notifies affected tribes
access_detail: Enrolled text fetched; signed 2025-05-31 per a bill tracker (Chapter 189, not confirmed on the official site). New section of NRS chapter 445A.
status_reason: Fetched: duty to notify NDEP electronically or by telephone, no deadline stated; tribe notice by NDEP; no public notice. Codified as NRS 445A.467 (official chapter, revision of 2026-04-15, read 2026-11-09).

name: NAC 445A.345 to 445A.348 release notification (hazardous substances, spill hotline)
status_reason: Fetched: release to surface water reported "as soon as practicable" by phone; land releases over 25 gallons by the first working day.

name: NDEP Nevada Environmental Activities portal (Report a Spill)
operator: Nevada Division of Environmental Protection, Bureau of Corrective Actions
access_detail: Fetched home page: spill reporting form, account login for case lookup; public search covers certifications only. No public spill list found. NDEP spill database is internal (2017 hotline presentation).
status_reason: Intake only (an online form and account login); no public view of the notices found.

name: Nevada HAB Dashboard (Office of State Epidemiology, Power BI) and weekly HAB email list
operator: Nevada HAB Task Force (NDEP, State Parks, NDOW, NDA, OSE)
access_detail: Power BI Gov embed (no data download or public data address found on 2026-11-09); NDEP page ndep.nv.gov/water/rivers-streams-lakes/water-quality-monitoring/harmful-algal-bloom-program; weekly updates by email list (subscribe via NDEP "Get Notices", list "Nevada Harmful Algal Bloom Updates", or NEVADAHABS-subscribe-request@LISTSERV.STATE.NV.US).
status_reason: A statewide bloom map, a Power BI report: on 2026-11-09 the page returned only its script shell, in which no rows, no download and no data address were found (the report's own data calls were not examined). Registered as a channel with the barrier; a supported export is an owner request.
notes: Watch/Warning advisories at Lahontan Reservoir and Washoe Lake in 2026 (news). The Office of State Epidemiology's list (nv-ose-hab-reports) gives the advisories as readable text, with one more that it says the dashboard does not show (South Meadows Community Pond, on private land with public access).

name: Nevada Office of State Epidemiology, Harmful Algal Bloom reports
access_detail: One web page: a count of the year's active advisories, then one heading per water with its advisory level and the date each level took effect, active and previous advisories.
cadence: updated when an advisory changes; no fixed schedule
status_reason: Read by the nv-ose-hab-reports ingester (ingest.nv_ose_hab_list): one hab_advisory record per advisory the active list states, the Office's level and words, the date the Office gives as the start; a whole-water advisory colours its water, a cove's is listed on the water; a water with no record here (Virginia Lake, Mountain View Pond, South Meadows Community Pond on 2026-11-16) is listed with its place; an advisory the parks' page also carries is shown once, as this record (the Office's stated date, the stricter level, both publishers cited), the parks' record its duplicate. Built and tested on the page as the pipeline's runner read it on 2026-11-16 (eleven advisories under eight headings).
notes: Headings on 2026-11-15: Mountain View Pond, Gardnerville (Watch, 10/14/2026), Lahontan Reservoir (Warning, 11/2/26), Lake Mohave including Placer Cove, Eagle Wash and Cottonwood Cove (Watch, 6/11, 9/9, 10/28/2026), Rye Patch Reservoir (Watch, 09/30/2026), Wild Horse Reservoir (Watch, 8/13/2026), Virginia Lake (Watch, 6/23/2026), South Meadows Community Pond (Watch, 6/23/2026), Walker Lake (Watch, lowered 5/19/26).

name: Nevada State Parks HAB advisory page
access_detail: The page's three accordion sections (HAB Watch, Warning and Danger Advisories): one bold heading per water with its update date, then the parks' paragraph; 'None' or 'None at this time.' for an empty level.
cannot_fill: started_at (no issue date: the first read is used)
ended_at (no lift date: the read that finds the water gone is used)
cadence: updated when a level changes; no fixed schedule
history: current advisories only; the Internet Archive holds monthly copies since 2025-10
status_reason: Read by the nv-state-parks-hab ingester: one hab_advisory record per water while listed, the parks' level and words, the first read as the start. The parser was built and tested on the Internet Archive's copies of 2025-11-12 (Rye Patch Watch, Lahontan Warning) and 2026-08-13 (Lahontan, Rye Patch, Marlette Lake and Washoe Lake Watch), and on the page as the pipeline read it on 2026-11-16 (Rye Patch and Wild Horse Watch, Lahontan Warning, no Danger).
notes: Waters in Nevada state parks only.
